reason: Sagebrush's sandbox runs in Safari and in iOS browsers built on WebKit: WebKit refuses the runner's blob: worker under the frame's COEP, so the runner page (web/runner/index.html, copied unchanged to engine/runner/index.html) starts a data: worker there, and elsewhere falls back to one, keeping the page's early messages for it.
